definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい}, referring to female middle school students.

examples.english: I have a daughter in middle school.

examples.japanese: JC{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Apps targeting middle school girls are increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧JC⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧だ。
examples.english: It's normal for middle school girls nowadays to have smartphones.

notes:
JC is an informal abbreviation for ⟦{女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい}→女子中学生：23376_joshichuugakusei⟧ (female middle school student). J = ⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧ (female), C = ⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：10973_chuugakusei⟧ (middle school student).

REGISTER:
This is casual/slang terminology used primarily on the internet, in social media, and in marketing aimed at youth. It is not used in formal writing or official contexts.

RELATED ABBREVIATIONS:
- JK: ⟦{女子高生|じょしこうせい}→女子高生：12381_joshikousei⟧ (high school girl) — the most commonly used of the series
- JD: ⟦{女子大生|じょしだいせい}→女子大生：23937_joshidaisei⟧ (female college student)
- JS: {女子小学生|じょししょうがくせい} (elementary school girl) — less common

USAGE:
These abbreviations focus on female students specifically. There is no widely used equivalent abbreviation series for male students.
